name: hud_ui_circle_hit_test_core
description: HudUiCircle::HitTestCore compares squared distance from the circle center against radiusSquared.
known_limits: tier S evidence is tracked by the grouped hud_ui_circle_hit_tests VC target.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4bc4e0 validates dx = px - base.x, dy = py - base.y, signed compare of dx*dx + dy*dy against radiusSquared, and a byte result via xor eax,eax; setl al.
The native circle smoke verifies center hits, interior hits, boundary misses, and outside misses through HitTestCore.
